objective.title: 🎯 Game Objective
objective.description: Be the first to reach 200 points to trigger the end of the game. Points are scored according to the sum of the numbered cards in front of you. Flipping 7 numbered cards ends the round and gives you a 15-point bonus. Warning: if you draw a card already present in your row, you are eliminated from the round and score no points!

deck.title: 🎴 Deck Composition
deck.description: The deck contains: twelve 12s, eleven 11s, ten 10s... down to one 1, and a 0 (worth 0 points). The higher the value, the more copies.
deck.cards: There are also Action cards (Flip Three, Freeze, Second Chance) and Modifier cards (+2 to +10, x2).

setup.title: 📋 Setup
setup.step1: Shuffle the deck and choose a dealer.
setup.step2: The dealer deals one face-up card to each player (including themselves).
setup.step3: If an Action card appears, stop dealing and resolve it immediately.
setup.step4: Once all Action cards are resolved, continue dealing until everyone has at least one card.

gameplay.title: ▶️ Round Gameplay
gameplay.description: In turn, each player chooses to draw a card (HIT) or stop (STOP) to keep their points.
gameplay.hit: HIT: Draw a card and add it to your row. Place modifiers above.
gameplay.stop: STOP: Leave the round and keep your current points.
gameplay.bust: BUST: If you draw a duplicate, you are eliminated from the round and score no points.
gameplay.flip7: Flip7: If you Flip7 numbered cards, the round ends for all and you get a 15-point bonus.

actionCards.title: 🎭 Action Cards
actionCards.description: Action cards are played as soon as they appear. Place them above your row.

freeze.title: FREEZE 🧊
freeze.description: The player who receives this card is eliminated for the rest of the round but keeps the points already earned.

flipThree.title: FLIP THREE 🎴
flipThree.description: The player must draw three cards in a row. If an Action card appears, it is resolved after.

secondChance.title: SECOND CHANCE 🍀
secondChance.description: Keep this card. If you draw a duplicate, discard the duplicate and the Second Chance card. Only one per player. All are discarded at the end of the round.

modifierCards.title: ⭐ Modifier Cards
modifierCards.plus: +2 to +10: Add the value to your total points.
modifierCards.times: x2: Double the sum of your numbered cards (excluding other modifiers).
modifierCards.note: Action and Modifier cards are never destroyed. Place them above your row.

scoring.title: 💯 Scoring
scoring.step1: Add up all your numbered cards.
scoring.step2: Double this total if you have an x2.
scoring.step4: If you flipped 7 numbered cards (Flip7), add 15 bonus points.

endTurn.title: ⏹️ End of Round
endTurn.case1: There are no more active players (all eliminated or stopped)
endTurn.case2: OR a player has flipped 7 numbered cards (Flip7)
endTurn.next: Set aside the cards from the round (do not reshuffle them). Pass the deck to the player on the left, who becomes the dealer.

endGame.title: 🏆 End of Game
endGame.description: The game ends if, at the end of a round, at least one player has reached 200 points. The player with the MOST points wins.
endGame.note: The first to 200 points is not necessarily the winner!

tips.title: 💡 Strategic Tips
tips.tip1: Count the cards played and those remaining.
tips.tip2: Watch out for duplicates, that's the main risk!
tips.tip3: Trying for Flip7 gives 15 bonus points and ends the round.
tips.tip4: Use Action cards at the right moment against your opponents.
